name: What should I do first if I want to replace my kitchen cabinets but have no idea where to start?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I want to replace my kitchen cabinets but have no idea where to start?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Start by deciding whether you need a cosmetic update or a full cabinet replacement. A consultation with Elite Remodeling & Design can review the layout, cabinet condition, storage problems, and related countertop, plumbing, or electrical work before materials are chosen.

**Context:** Replacing cabinets in the same general locations is simpler than changing walls, appliances, or utility connections. Hidden water damage, uneven floors, and out-of-square walls can affect the plan.

**Key factors:**
- Cabinet box condition and moisture damage
- Desired storage, door style, and accessibility
- Appliance dimensions and clearances
- Whether the sink, lighting, gas, or electrical service will move

**Practical guidance:** Photograph the existing kitchen, measure appliances, and list the problems you want solved. Ask for a written scope that separates cabinets from countertops, finish work, and trade changes.

Elite Remodeling & Design can coordinate design development and construction planning as one residential remodeling project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin with a layout and condition review, not cabinet shopping. Document your kitchen, appliances, storage problems, and preferred style, then have Elite Remodeling & Design determine whether the project needs only cabinets or also countertops, plumbing, electrical, or layout changes.
